findings.message: The release test imports the input guard, plan builder, and TARGET-CAS coordinator but manually constructs the plan and invokes checkpoint/adapter directly. It does not prove the released end-to-end chain.

npm verify cannot resolve ajv from the isolated worktree although the declared parent dependency tree exists. The exact canonical gate must be run authoritatively in the parent integration checkout after candidate integration; do not install or modify dependencies in the task worktree.
